test_cases.test_case: Search clients by name/account/external ID/mobile
preconditions: User logged in as <Admin>
Multiple clients exist with distinguishable Name, Account No., External ID, and Mobile Number
steps: 2. Enter <search term> in the Search field (searches by Name, Account No., External ID, or Mobile Number)
3. Press Enter or click the Search action
test_cases.expected_result: Clients table displays only rows matching <search term> in Name, Account No., External ID, or Mobile Number; unrelated rows are no longer visible

test_cases.test_case: Filter clients by Status = Active
preconditions: User logged in as <Admin>
Clients exist in various statuses including Active
steps: 2. Open the Status filter dropdown in the filter bar
test_cases.expected_result: Clients table displays only rows with Status badge 'Active' (green); rows with other statuses are not visible

test_cases.test_case: Open Create Client wizard and create a client with required fields (happy path)
preconditions: User logged in as <User with create-client permission>
steps: 2. Click the 'Create Client' button to open the Create Client wizard
3. In Step 1 (General Details) enter <Office> in Office, <First Name> in First Name, <Last Name> in Last Name, and <Submitted On> in Submitted On (fill required fields)
4. Click Next to progress through Steps 2 and 3 without adding optional entries
5. In Step 4 (Identifiers) leave optional identifiers empty
test_cases.expected_result: Client Detail page opens for the newly created client and the Status badge shows 'Pending' (yellow)

test_cases.test_case: Create client and add a Family Member in Step 3 repeating group
preconditions: User logged in as <User with create-client permission>
steps: 2. Click 'Create Client' to open the Create Client wizard
3. In Step 1 enter required fields: <Office>, <First Name>, <Last Name>, and <Submitted On>
4. Click Next to Step 2, then Next to Step 3 (Family Members)
5. In Step 3 click 'Add Row' to add a new family member
6. In the new family member row enter <family member details>
7. Click Next to Step 4 and then click 'Submit'
test_cases.expected_result: Client Detail page opens and the Family Members tab shows the added family member entry (one entry for the added family member is visible)

test_cases.test_case: Create client and add an Identifier in Step 4 repeating group
preconditions: User logged in as <User with create-client permission>
steps: 2. Click 'Create Client' to open the Create Client wizard
3. In Step 1 enter required fields: <Office>, <First Name>, <Last Name>, and <Submitted On>
5. In Step 4 click 'Add Row' to add a new Identifier
6. Enter <Document Type> in Document Type and <Document Key> in Document Key for the new row
test_cases.expected_result: Client Detail page opens and the Identifiers tab displays the added identifier row with the entered Document Type and Document Key

test_cases.test_case: Download Client Excel template from Bulk Import page
preconditions: User logged in as <Admin>
steps: 2. Click the 'Import Client' top-right button to open the Bulk Import page
test_cases.expected_result: Client Excel template download is triggered in the browser

test_cases.test_case: Upload a completed client import file and see import history entry
preconditions: User logged in as <Admin>
A valid completed client import file is available as <valid import file>
steps: 2. Click 'Import Client' to open the Bulk Import page
3. Click 'Upload Completed File' and select <valid import file> from the OS file dialog
test_cases.expected_result: A new row appears in the Import History table with Name matching <valid import file> and Total Records showing a numeric value; the new row is visible in the import history list

test_cases.test_case: Open a client's Detail page from the Clients table (Name link)
preconditions: User logged in as <User>
A client exists in Pending status
steps: 2. Click the client's Name link in the Name column to open Client Detail
test_cases.expected_result: Client Detail page opens showing the client name, Account No., Office, and a Status badge 'Pending' (yellow)

test_cases.test_case: Activate a Pending client by entering a valid Activation Date
preconditions: User logged in as <User with client-action permission>
A client exists in Pending status with a known <Submitted On> date
steps: 2. Click the Pending client's Name to open Client Detail
4. In the Activate dialog enter <Activation_Date> (must not be before <Submitted On>)
5. Click Confirm on the Activate dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Status badge updates to 'Active' (green) on the Client Detail page

test_cases.test_case: Reject a Pending client by providing a reason
preconditions: User logged in as <User with client-action permission>
A client exists in Pending status
steps: 2. Click the Pending client's Name to open Client Detail
5. Click Confirm on the Reject dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Status badge updates to 'Rejected' (red) on the Client Detail page

test_cases.test_case: Withdraw a Pending client by providing a reason
preconditions: User logged in as <User with client-action permission>
A client exists in Pending status
steps: 2. Click the Pending client's Name to open Client Detail
5. Click Confirm on the Withdraw dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Status badge updates to 'Withdrawn' (orange) on the Client Detail page

test_cases.test_case: Transfer an Active client to a different Office
preconditions: User logged in as <User with client-action permission>
A client exists in Active status in <Current_Office>
A different office <Destination_Office> exists
steps: 2. Click the Active client's Name to open Client Detail
4. In the Transfer dialog select <Destination_Office> (must not equal <Current_Office>)
5. Click Confirm on the Transfer dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Client Detail page shows Office updated to <Destination_Office>

test_cases.test_case: Close an Active client when no active accounts exist
preconditions: User logged in as <User with client-action permission>
A client exists in Active status with no active accounts
steps: 2. Click the Active client's Name to open Client Detail
5. Click Confirm on the Close dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Status badge updates to 'Closed' (gray) on the Client Detail page

test_cases.test_case: Reactivate a Closed client
preconditions: User logged in as <User with client-action permission>
A client exists in Closed status
steps: 2. Click the Closed client's Name to open Client Detail
4. Click Confirm on the Reactivate dialog if shown
test_cases.expected_result: Status badge updates to 'Active' (green) on the Client Detail page

test_cases.test_case: Create Client — leave required unspecified field (Office) blank
preconditions: User is on Create Client wizard Step 1 (General Details)
steps: 2. Fill First Name with <valid first name>
3. Fill Last Name with <valid last name>
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; 'Office' field displays an inline validation error indicating it is required; client is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Create Client — leave required date (Submitted On) blank
preconditions: User is on Create Client wizard Step 1 (General Details)
steps: 2. Fill First Name with <valid first name>
3. Fill Last Name with <valid last name>
4. Ensure Submitted On field is empty
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; 'Submitted On' field displays an inline validation error indicating it is required; client is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Create Client — submit with ALL required fields empty
preconditions: User is on Create Client wizard Step 1 (General Details)
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; inline validation errors appear on the required fields ('Office', 'First Name', 'Last Name', 'Submitted On') indicating they are required; no client is created.

test_cases.test_case: Create Client — duplicate External ID (uniqueness constraint)
preconditions: An existing client already has External ID = <existing external id>
User is on Create Client wizard Step 1 (General Details)
steps: 2. Fill First Name with <valid first name>
3. Fill Last Name with <valid last name>
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; 'External ID' field displays an inline validation error indicating the value must be unique; client is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Client Identifiers — add duplicate Document_Type+Document_Key (no-duplicates constraint)
preconditions: User is on the Client Detail page, Identifiers tab for an existing client
steps: 2. In Identifier row 1 set Document Type = <type A>
3. In Identifier row 1 set Document Key = <key X>
5. In Identifier row 2 set Document Type = <type A>
6. In Identifier row 2 set Document Key = <key X>
test_cases.expected_result: Save is blocked; a validation error appears on the duplicated identifier rows stating 'Duplicate Document Type + Document Key not allowed' (inline near the Identifier rows); duplicate identifiers are not saved.

test_cases.test_case: Pending → Activate — leave required Activation Date blank
preconditions: Client is in Pending status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 2. Ensure Activation Date field is empty
3. Click Confirm/Submit on the Activate dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; Activate dialog shows an inline validation error on 'Activation Date' indicating it is required; client status remains Pending.

test_cases.test_case: Pending → Activate — Activation Date before Submitted On (date-order constraint)
preconditions: Client is in Pending status with Submitted On = <submitted date> and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 2. Enter Activation Date = <date earlier than submitted date>
3. Click Confirm/Submit on the Activate dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; Activate dialog displays an inline validation error on 'Activation Date' stating it must not be before Submitted On; client status remains Pending.

test_cases.test_case: Pending → Reject — leave required Reason blank
preconditions: Client is in Pending status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 3. Click Confirm/Submit on the Reject dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; Reject dialog shows an inline validation error on 'Reason' indicating it is required; client status remains Pending.

test_cases.test_case: Pending → Withdraw — leave required Reason blank
preconditions: Client is in Pending status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 3. Click Confirm/Submit on the Withdraw dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; Withdraw dialog shows an inline validation error on 'Reason' indicating it is required; client status remains Pending.

test_cases.test_case: Active → Transfer Client — leave required Destination Office blank
preconditions: Client is in Active status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 2. Ensure Destination Office field is empty
3. Click Confirm/Submit on the Transfer dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; Transfer dialog shows an inline validation error on 'Destination Office' indicating it is required; client is not moved.

test_cases.test_case: Active → Transfer Client — select Destination Office equal to Current Office (constraint violation)
preconditions: Client is in Active status with Current Office = <office A> and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 2. Select Destination Office = <office A> (same as Current Office)
3. Click Confirm/Submit on the Transfer dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; Transfer dialog displays an inline validation error on 'Destination Office' indicating it must not equal the current office; client remains in the current office.

test_cases.test_case: Active → Close — leave required Closure Reason blank
preconditions: Client is in Active status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 2. Ensure Closure Reason field is empty
3. Click Confirm/Submit on the Close dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; Close dialog shows an inline validation error on 'Closure Reason' indicating it is required; client status remains Active.

test_cases.test_case: Active → Close — attempt close when client has active accounts (constraint prevents close)
preconditions: Client is in Active status and has at least one active account
User is on the Client Detail page
steps: 3. Click Confirm/Submit on the Close dialog
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; Close dialog or page displays a visible error indicating the client cannot be closed because there are active accounts (e.g., 'cannot close with active accounts'); client status remains Active.

test_cases.test_case: Wrong-state: Pending — 'Close' action not available
preconditions: Client is in Pending status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 1. Inspect the state-bound action bar for the Pending client
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Close' action button is not visible in the action bar for a Pending client; no UI control exists to perform Close from Pending state.

test_cases.test_case: Wrong-state: Active — 'Activate' action not available
preconditions: Client is in Active status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 1. Inspect the state-bound action bar for the Active client
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Activate' action button is not visible in the action bar for an Active client; no UI control exists to perform Activate from Active state.

test_cases.test_case: Wrong-state: Closed — 'Transfer Client' action not available
preconditions: Client is in Closed status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 1. Inspect the state-bound action bar for the Closed client
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Transfer Client' action button is not visible in the action bar for a Closed client; no UI control exists to perform Transfer from Closed state.

test_cases.test_case: Wrong-state: Rejected — no actions are visible
preconditions: Client is in Rejected status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 1. Inspect the state-bound action bar for the Rejected client
test_cases.expected_result: No action buttons are visible in the action bar for a Rejected client; no actions can be initiated from the UI in this state.

test_cases.test_case: Wrong-state: Withdrawn — no actions are visible
preconditions: Client is in Withdrawn status and user is on the Client Detail page
steps: 1. Inspect the state-bound action bar for the Withdrawn client
test_cases.expected_result: No action buttons are visible in the action bar for a Withdrawn client; no actions can be initiated from the UI in this state.

test_cases.test_case: Create Client — invalid Email Address format
preconditions: User is on Create Client wizard Step 1 (General Details)
steps: 2. Fill First Name with <valid first name>
3. Fill Last Name with <valid last name>
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; 'Email Address' field displays an inline validation error indicating the value is not a valid email format; client is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Activate with Activation_Date equal to Submitted_On (boundary pass)
preconditions: A client exists in Pending status with a known Submitted_On date <Submitted_On>
steps: 2. Click the client's Name to open Client Detail
test_cases.expected_result: Activation succeeds; client status is set to Active and the status badge changes to Active; Activation_Date displayed on the Client Detail equals <Submitted_On>

test_cases.test_case: Activate with Activation_Date one day before Submitted_On (boundary fail)
preconditions: A client exists in Pending status with a known Submitted_On date <Submitted_On>
steps: 2. Click the client's Name to open Client Detail
4. Enter <one day before Submitted_On> in the Activation_Date field
test_cases.expected_result: Activation is blocked; an inline error is shown on the Activation_Date field indicating the date must not be before Submitted_On (Activation is blocked / error shown)

test_cases.test_case: Transfer Client where Destination_Office equals Current_Office (equality boundary fail)
preconditions: A client exists in Active status and has Current_Office set to <Current_Office>
steps: 2. Click the client's Name to open Client Detail
test_cases.expected_result: Transfer is blocked; an inline error is shown on Destination_Office indicating Destination_Office must not equal Current_Office (is blocked / error shown)

test_cases.test_case: Transfer Client to a different Destination_Office (equality boundary pass)
preconditions: A client exists in Active status and has Current_Office set to <Current_Office>
There exists another office <Different_Office> different from <Current_Office>
steps: 2. Click the client's Name to open Client Detail
test_cases.expected_result: Transfer succeeds; the client is moved to <Different_Office> and the Office field on the Client Detail shows <Different_Office>

test_cases.test_case: Rapid re-submission after Create Client success — ensure no duplicate client created
preconditions: User can access Create Client wizard
There is no existing client with the combination of identifying fields to be used in this test
steps: 2. Click 'Create Client' to open the Create Client wizard
3. Enter a valid value in Office
8. After the success redirect to Client Detail, click the browser Back button
9. Attempt to click 'Submit' again from the returned page (if Submit is available)
test_cases.expected_result: Second submission attempt is blocked; only one client record is created with those identifying fields (no duplicate appears in the Clients list)

test_cases.test_case: Add then remove all Family Members in wizard, then submit (repeating_group remove-all edge)
preconditions: User can access Create Client wizard (Family Members step exists and is optional)
steps: 2. Click 'Create Client' to open the Create Client wizard
3. Complete Step 1 required fields (Office, First_Name, Last_Name, Submitted_On)
8. Remove the second Family_Member entry (resulting in zero entries)
9. Navigate to final step and click 'Submit'
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission succeeds; client is created in Pending status and Client Detail shows zero Family Members entries (submission succeeds with zero items)

test_cases.test_case: First Name with leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed on save
preconditions: User can access Create Client wizard
steps: 2. Click 'Create Client' to open the Create Client wizard
4. Enter a First_Name value with leading and trailing whitespace (e.g., '<leading and trailing whitespace>')
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; Client Detail displays First Name with leading/trailing whitespace removed (saved value has no extra leading or trailing spaces)

test_cases.test_case: External_ID containing special characters and emoji is accepted and shown exactly
preconditions: User can access Create Client wizard
The External_ID value to be used does not conflict with an existing External_ID
steps: 2. Click 'Create Client' to open the Create Client wizard
4. Enter values in First_Name and Last_Name
6. Enter a special-character/unicode (including emoji) string in External_ID (e.g., '<special/unicode string>')
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; Client Detail shows the External ID exactly as entered including special characters/emoji (saved External ID matches input)
